My dear [Christabel](/person/329)

Thanks for the grand faithful [Gosling](/topic/104) card, which is capital.

These two Escorials are all that Goosedom has produced[^2] I never expected any thing of it at Christmas They both seem to be of the childish good kind.

No, I have not seen Garnstone. [Warne](/person/1433) is not very liberal of his books. I don’t know what school children would do but for the happy dispensation that makes their own people prefer them to all others!

Our mistress is I believe to visit a friend in your parish next week. I can’t say I prefer her to all others!

She is quite devoid of the moral influence [her predecessor](/person/1178) had

your affectionate

C M Yonge

[Florence Wilford](/person/1520)’s [Aunt](/person/384) died on Monday-


[^1]: The paper has an ornamental decoration: \'Dear Friend Accept This CHRISTMAS Greeting Heart with Heart in Memory Meeting\'.
[^2]: The Goslings had been asked to write an essay on ‘The history of the Escorial’, a theme proposed by Pixie (CMY to Mary Fursdon, 15 November 1872)
